# Genesis Apocryphon Column 10 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QapGen (Cave 1), Col. 10 | **Condition:** Nearly destroyed

---

**10:1** [...] the mountains [...] of Ararat [...]

**10:2** [...] the ark settled [...] on the mountaintops [...]

**10:3** [...] slowly the waters drained [...] from the face of the earth [...]

**10:4** [...] Noah opened [...] the window [...]

**10:5** [...] he released the dove [...]

**10:6** [...] it came back to him [...] carrying an olive leaf [...]

**10:7** [...] freshly torn [...] in its beak [...]

**10:8** [...]

---

*PNEUMA notes: Column 10 brings the first sign of hope after the devastation. The ark finds solid ground on Ararat, and the dove returns bearing an olive leaf — proof that life has survived the judgment. Even in fragments, this moment of grace shines through.*
